findings.current: Even so, Mu Song narrowed his eyes as the cannonballs fell far short of the hulls and slammed into the water.
findings.defect: “Fell far short” specifies a direction the source does not give; the cannonballs miss the hulls by a wide margin.
findings.rationale: 한참이나 선체를 빗나가 describes the extent of the miss, not whether the shots landed short.
findings.replacement: Even so, Mu Song narrowed his eyes as cannonballs missed the hulls by a wide margin and slammed into the water.
findings.source: 한참이나 선체를 빗나가 수면 위를 후려치는 포탄들을 본 무송이 눈매를 좁혔다.

findings.current: *Even if it’s my Master’s order… I can’t bring myself to go along with it.*
findings.defect: Mu Song’s reluctance becomes an inability or decision to comply, though he continues the attack.
findings.rationale: 도무지 내키지 않는군 expresses strong unwillingness, not refusal.
findings.replacement: *Even if it’s my Master’s order… this doesn’t sit right with me at all.*

findings.current: Amid the thunderous blast, Mu Song landed on the bow, deflecting the cannonball. He felt the tingling in his grip and shouted:
findings.defect: The draft omits the recoil from deflecting the cannonball as the cause of his landing.
findings.rationale: 포탄을 튕겨낸 반동으로 explicitly links the deflection’s recoil to his landing.
findings.replacement: Amid the thunderous blast, the recoil from deflecting the cannonball sent Mu Song back onto the bow. His grip tingled, and he shouted:
findings.source: 포탄을 튕겨낸 반동으로 뱃머리에 착지한 무송은 저릿해진 손아귀를 느끼며 외쳤다.

findings.current: *Come to think of it, that made me a chivalrous hero too, for a little while.*
findings.defect: The thought omits that Mu Song helped those heroes—the specific basis for his brief claim to chivalry.
findings.rationale: 그들을 도왔던 나 makes his own aid to them essential to the thought.
findings.replacement: *Come to think of it, since I helped them, was I a chivalrous hero for a little while too?*
findings.source: ‘그러고 보면, 그들을 도왔던 나 역시 잠시 동안은 협객이었던 셈인가.’

findings.current: “…We’ll finish this in one strike. Everyone, get ready.”
findings.defect: “One strike” introduces a single-blow tactic absent from the order.
findings.rationale: 단숨에 means in one go or without delay, not with one literal strike.
findings.replacement: “…We’ll finish this quickly. Everyone, get ready.”

summary: The draft changes two consequential facts: where the cannonballs land and whether Mu Song has decided to refuse his master’s order. It also loses the recoil behind his landing and the reason he briefly considers himself a hero.
